content.comment_body: Hello experts, I am using [product_name] V8.2.1, and in the dropdown menu I only see arithmetic functions, not the mathematical functions mentioned in the manual and online help. The software only lets me use fixed numbers between -32000 and +32000 as variables, instead of outputs from other function blocks. Why is this? Kind regards, [user_name]
It’s a bit unclear what you mean. The [product_name] software only shows blocks that are selectable by the current device. I think you may not have chosen the right [product_name] device.

Thank you for your quick response. I selected [article_no], the most recent in the list. Let me clarify: According to the manual and online help (see chapter 5.3.38): parameters V1-V4 can be set to actual values of other function blocks. In my software, V8.2.1, only fixed values are offered, not output values from other blocks. Any ideas?

I think I see what you mean. You want to reference the value of another numeric block in a parameter for a mathematical operation. If you're using [product_name] [article_no] for the first time, you’ll notice the reference capability works differently compared to previous devices. How do you set up references between blocks in [product_name] [version_no]?
Thanks, your explanation resolved my issue. Yes, this is my first "08" device—should’ve checked the tutorial even with my years of experience on "06". Lesson learned!
No worries! The main thing is that you got help. But do make sure to consult the correct user manual.

A quick follow-up: I tested parameter connections—they work as described. However, when using the output of an analog multiplexer as the input for a timer (like TH, TL…) on a relay, the timing unit switches to milliseconds automatically. This seems to limit the functionality—is this a bug?
No, that isn't a bug. After creating a reference line, you just need to select your preferred time unit—ms, 1/10 ms, seconds, or minutes.

Thanks again for your quick reply. I thought it would work as you described. I see the arrows for parameters like "T", but clicking on them doesn't open a dropdown menu—very odd. I’ve included my small program. Are you able to access the menu? I'm on V8.2.1 (Jan 28, 2019).
I'm also using V8.2.1. When you open the parameter field, click the triangle icon. That should open the dropdown menu.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered confusion when setting up parameters for arithmetic and mathematical functions in [product_name] V8.2.1, especially when referencing outputs from other function blocks rather than using fixed values. Differences in interface behavior between device generations led to misunderstandings, and some users experienced issues with parameter selection and automatic time unit switching that limited the software’s usability. Documentation not matching current product operation remains a key challenge for users switching from older models.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to reference outputs from other function blocks as variable parameters and to manually select time units in drop-down menus, as described in the documentation and previously available in older software versions.
